description: A named signer declines an envelope. The Worker transitions the envelope to terminal `declined` state and notifies the requester. Decline is irreversible — re-signing requires a fresh envelope via `requestEnvelope`.

reason.description: Free-form decline reason (Markdown). Surfaces in the requester's notification thread.

errors.name: NotASigner
errors.description: signerDid is not in the envelope's signers array.

errors.name: EnvelopeNotOpen
errors.description: Envelope is already in a terminal state.
